## Log

(chronological notes below)

### Step 1: `scripts/check-claims.mjs`

New standalone script, mirrors `check-copy.mjs`'s file-set convention
(`locales/*.json` + `locales/partials/*.json`). Eight rule classes:
superlative, health-outcome, professional-title, payment-name,
threshold-literal, reply-time, official-distributor, invented-number.
Per-key allowlist with a mandatory reason (`ALLOWLIST` export), for a real
regex match that is not the claim the rule exists to catch (two gated
"official distributors" keys, one EN sentence that uses "best" to mean "not
the best-known brand", i.e. advice against choosing by brand fame).

Two false-positive classes found and fixed by refining the script itself
(never by weakening a rule against a real violation):
- `مدى` (payment mark) vs `على مدى` (ordinary MSA "over a span of time"):
  exempted when the preceding word is `على`, same technique
  `check-strings.mjs` already uses.
- `آمن` (health-safety verdict) vs `دفع آمن` (secure checkout, unrelated
  sense): exempted when the preceding word is `دفع`/`الدفع`.
- `طبيب`/`أخصائي` used to redirect the reader to an *outside* professional
  ("راجع طبيبك", and three `ox.tax.services.*` values in S1's partial: "لا
  تغني عن استشارة طبيب أو أخصائي تغذية مرخص") vs a self-description: a
  value containing a redirect marker (راجع، استشارة، استشر، زيارة، تغني
  عن، يغني عن، مراجعة) is exempted from the whole rule.

Baseline before any content fix: 32 problems (14 AR titles + 1 EN title +
1 AR `faq_3_a`, each counted once per file: base + declaring partial).
Baseline after the content fixes in step 4: 0 problems, 6 allowlisted.

### Step 2: MSA/dialect/numeral sweep

`pnpm check:copy` was already 0 at the start (conductor's T0 diacritic-only
fix on `faq_3_a` held). Independent sweep beyond `check-copy.mjs`'s own
word list: no whole-word hit for `يشتغل`, `ما فيه`, `الإيميل`, `حق`,
`ابغى` anywhere in `locales/ar.json` or any partial (a handful of
substring false positives checked by hand: `زين` inside `كازين`, `بس`
inside `الشبس`, `تبي` inside `تبيع`). No tatweel (U+0640) in `ar.json` or
`en.json`. Numerals: every digit found in `ar.json` sits in a technical or
price context (dosage grams/mg/IU, ml, minutes, hours-before-appointment,
serving counts, ratings) which the doctrine keeps in Latin digits; every
narrative ordinal already reads as a spelled word ("الأول... الثاني...
الثالث... الرابع" in `ox.content.goals.performance.explainer_1`), not a
digit. No change needed.

### Step 3: Per-page vocabulary pass

Compared h1/title/chip_*/intro for all 15 categories and 6 goals against
`keywords-ar.md` §2 head queries and §5.2 canonical synonym terms: every
H1 and title already matches its cluster's research row verbatim (AR and
EN), and every chip already uses the canonical spelling (بي سي اي اي، اي
اي اي، محلل مائيا، كونسنتريت، ايزوليت، جولد ستاندرد territory not needed
here, ملتي فيتامين، فيتامين د3، مغنيسيوم، الكتروليت). Brand spellings
(§7.1) appear once in category copy (`ox.content.categories.
whey_isolate.faq_2_a`, "ديماتيز") and already match the recommended form.
`claims-audit.md` Findings 10-11 (vitamins_minerals chips for a
non-existent "فيتامين سي"/"زنك" line, and a "جليسينات" chip implying a
form the one magnesium SKU is not) are no longer present in the current
chip list, resolved before this batch, verified still fixed. No
vocabulary edits were needed; see step 4 for the claims-driven edits.

See `docs/content/changes-2026-09-21.md` §1-§4 for the full old→new table.

### Step 5: EN sweep against §6

All 15 category + 6 goal H1/title pairs checked against `keywords-ar.md`

Beyond §6, found and fixed a real AR/EN parity break: the owner's commits
